reviewedItems.derivation: Replications: one before either sequence. Divisions: one in mitosis, two in meiosis. Pairing: no meiotic homologue pairing in mitosis; homologues pair in meiosis I. Separation: sisters in mitosis; homologues in meiosis I, sisters in II. Products: two versus four. Ploidy/count per product: 2n=6 versus n=3. Similarity: mitosis normally preserves the complement; meiosis can create new allele combinations through exchange and independent orientation. Mutations can occur, so neither process guarantees complete sequence identity.
